prompts.orc: Create ONE SIDE-PROFILE WALK KEYFRAME sprite, transparent alpha background. Image 1 is the EXISTING CHARACTER IDENTITY and ink rendering style. Image 2 is MOVEMENT STORYBOARD reference ONLY: match the forward-leaning thick chest silhouette, head thrust slightly ahead of shoulders, broad deliberately advancing stride and LOW axe carry from its first contact pose. Redraw the exact orc from Image 1 into STRICT side profile facing RIGHT, profile view nose and one eye, one ear, both arms visible at different depths. Keep original green muscular body, scar, tusks, black tied topknot, dark shoulder fur and leather X harness with single round buckle and red split waistcloth, boots and TWO short iron axes. Maintain original heavy hand-inked black shapes and angular grain, no new steel shoulder armor. CONTACT WALKING POSE: near leg extended forward to right, heel contacts on right, knee slightly bent, rear leg extends backward to left with toe at the same floor line and heel lifted. Feet at least a boot length apart. Pelvis centered between feet, torso leans FORWARD 12 degrees from upright, neck long enough for head to extend to the right and eyes look straight forward. Near arm hangs behind hip at left, elbow gently bent, hand near upper thigh gripping a short axe with head hanging down behind. Far arm is a little ahead of hip toward right, hand lower than belt, second short axe head hangs down slightly forward. Axe heads readable with full silhouettes, do not cover the knees or calves. Shoulder line compact. Full body including feet, all of hair and both axes in transparent margins, no floor, ground shadow, outlines outside the character, motion trails, text, labels or panels. Square image single game sprite.
prompts.elf: Create ONE SIDE-PROFILE STEALTH WALK KEYFRAME sprite on true transparent alpha background. Image 1 is the EXISTING CHARACTER IDENTITY and exact chunky black ink style. Image 2 is the MOVEMENT STORYBOARD reference: closely match its very low bent-knee stance, sharply inclined back, gaze horizontal to the right and TWO hands holding opposing daggers at hip height. Redraw the exact adult female dark elf from Image 1 in STRICT side profile facing RIGHT. Preserve her slate purple skin, narrow feminine angular face, long pointed ear with two silver hoops, original huge single silver-white braid, worn dark aubergine leather armor, short dark red split waist sash and black strapped boots. Match the original Darkest Dungeon ink rendering in Image 1. This is quiet cat-like travel with intention: torso leans forward about 28 degrees, hip remains LOW, knees bent about 25–40 degrees and pelvis height about 40 percent of total crouched height. Shoulders above/forward of hips, chin gently lifted and eyes staring ahead, neck aligned, determined and alert. CONTACT POSE: near foot far forward to right, near thigh sloping DOWN AND FORWARD, shin sloping down-forward to heel on floor; far leg extends behind to left with toe on same implied floor line. Clear gap between legs, visible boot tips. Near elbow bent backward, near hand at hip level behind the waist (left of pelvis) holding the dagger pointed backward to left. Far forearm extends ahead to right, far hand ahead of waist gripping the second dagger pointed forward to right. TWO daggers plainly visible, every grip secure. Blades near horizontal and never point down at the legs. No full cape to hide legs, hair arcs back left, all boots/knife tips/hair fully in frame with transparent margin. Full body, one original character game cutout, no floor, shadow, environment, magic, motion traces, lettering, numbers or panels. Square.
